details:
Q1: How should plan handle resolver exit 75 when CI-triage routing is on, so that a GitHub rate limit stops showing up as a `plan_failed` workflow failure?
Choices:
A) Defer instead of failing, like the existing #7516 `label_missing` hold at `.github/workflows/plan.yml:305-316,355-447`. Set `SKIP_PLAN=true` and `resolver_status=failed`, write no ref, and log a `::warning::INTEGRATION_REF_RESOLVE outcome=deferred reason=rate_limited` line. Exit 0 without falling back to the default branch. Keep `ai:planning` so standalone stall recovery re-posts `/answer` after the limit resets. Write no comment and no label, so a rate-limited step makes no extra API calls. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Hold the issue the way `label_missing` does: post a marker comment and apply `ai:blocked`. A human then has to `/reclarify`. Planning never falls back to the default branch.
C) Keep `exit 1` and change only how the failure is reported, for example a step output or log marker that the heal intake can read as transient. Note: the heal intake classifier sits outside this issue's allowed paths, so this option may need re-scoping.
Q2: Which resolver exit codes should get the Q1 treatment?
Choices:
A) Only exit 75 (rate-limited). Exit 2 (`api_unavailable`, permanent or exhausted transient errors) and exit 3 (routing refused) keep failing the job as they do now. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Both exit 75 and exit 2.
**Note:** B with Q1:A could hide permanent API errors, for example a revoked token or a 404, behind a quiet deferral.
Q3: The heal scope also lists `.github/workflows/internal-plan.yml`. Should the fix touch it?
Choices:
A) Change only the `Resolve integration ref` step in `.github/workflows/plan.yml`. Touch `internal-plan.yml` only if it has its own copy of the exit-75 branch, plus a regression test in `tests/` and a `changelog.d/` fragment. The test drives the step with a stubbed resolver that exits 75: it must fail on the reported head and pass with the fix. (RECOMMENDED)
B) Change both workflows even if `internal-plan.yml` only calls `plan.yml`.
